           LINUM USITATISSIMUM

         Common Flax


The application of Linseed poultice has produced in sensitive subjects
        severe respiratory disturbances, as asthma, hives, etc. Its action in such cases is marked
        by   intense irritation  . It has been found to contain
        small quantity of Hydrocyanic acid, which may account for this intensity. The decoction is
        of service in inflammation of the urinary passages, cystitis, strangury, etc. Also in
        diseases of the intestinal tract. It has a place in the treatment of asthma, hay-fever and
        urticaria. Trismus and paralysis of the tongue.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Linum
        Catharticum  -Purging flax --(Similar respiratory symptoms, but also colic and
        diarrhœa).



Dose.--  Lower potencies.
